newsitem.title: USA: Cisco sees 6-10 acquisitions in 12 months.
newsitem.headline: Cisco sees 6-10 acquisitions in 12 months.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc expects to acquire six to 10 new companies in the next 12 months, Chief Executive Officer John Chambers said.

Chambers, speaking at the Montgomery Securities Conference, said most of the acquisitions will be to acquire new or next generation technology. He mentioned in an interview that Cisco's recently acquired Granite Systems Inc is typical of what it will pursue -- a small company with cutting edge, next generation technology that no one else matched.
Chambers also said Cisco's quarterly revenue growth will continue to vacillate quarter to quarter because of increasingly short lead times in product sales.

Lead times, or the length of time between when customers order a product and when they want them delivered, have shrunk to one-to-four weeks before they want them. That compares with lead times of eight weeks to 12 weeks a year ago, he said.
This variation is partly to explain why revenue grew 19 percent between its second and third quarter and then jumped 31 percent between its third and fourth quarters.
He said lead times of one-to-four weeks will continue for the foreseeable future. New directions he sees Cisco entering soon are efforts to further integrate voice, data and video in its products.
"You'll see us move quickly in integrating voice, data, adn video across our product line," he said.
Cisco will also focus more efforts on the Dial up market for Internet access and on the networking security marketplace of firewall and encryption software.
